title: Preliminary held-out-site evaluation of measured power
target: Arithmetic mean active power of qualified hourly samples, in kW; not monthly kWh
split: Leave one entire site out, three folds. No random row split.
training_weight: Each training site has equal weight; each accepted hour within that site has equal weight

quality_rules.missing_values: Exclude nonfinite power samples; do not impute zero
quality_rules.operating_faults: Retain measured power under documented operating constraints; do not infer unconstrained demand

fallback: If a local-hour profile lacks data from either training site, use the constant baseline
aggregation: Per-site results primary; macro metrics give each of the three sites equal weight
uncertainty: No calibrated intervals or significance claims with three heterogeneous sites
tuning: No hyperparameter search or changes based on held-out scores; both baselines reported
honesty: Protocol fixed before this evaluation run, not an externally registered or blinded study. Source summaries had already been inspected.
time_scope: Retrospective cross-site transfer benchmark, not a chronological deployment backtest; training campaigns may be later than held-out campaigns
